comparison.objective: Chock a rolling cradle before unloading it, rather than tune a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual chock placement followed by load transfer; no fine rotary adjustment or tool engagement.
comparison.success_condition: Both chocks seated, cradle controlled, load placed, grippers released. Thresholds are omitted; no spec versions are present.
comparison.reason: Generic stabilization and safety sequencing do not create meaningful overlap.
